resources.name: LangChain
resources.description: The most popular framework for building LLM-powered applications. Provides a modular ecosystem for chains, agents, tools, memory, and RAG integration with 700+ built-in integrations.

paid_plan.summary: LangSmith Enterprise: custom pricing for advanced observability and monitoring

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

resources.name: CrewAI
resources.description: Multi-agent orchestration framework for creating role-based AI teams. Agents with specific roles collaborate like a crew to complete complex tasks through delegation and coordination.

free_tier.summary: Open source under MIT license. Self-hosted with any LLM (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic). No usage limits.

paid_plan.summary: CrewAI Enterprise: team collaboration features, custom pricing

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

resources.name: AutoGen
resources.description: Microsoft's multi-agent conversation framework enabling agents to converse, collaborate, and solve tasks. Supports code generation, execution, debugging, and human-in-the-loop interactions.

free_tier.summary: Open source under MIT license. Fully free self-hosted with AutoGen Studio GUI included.

paid_plan.summary: No paid version; entire framework is free and open source

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

resources.name: PydanticAI
resources.description: Type-safe Python agent framework built on Pydantic. Provides structured outputs with validation, dependency injection, and streaming — all verified at compile time.

free_tier.summary: Open source under MIT license. Fully free self-hosted with any LLM provider.

paid_plan.summary: No paid version; entire framework is free and open source

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

resources.name: Semantic Kernel
resources.description: Microsoft's enterprise AI orchestration SDK integrating LLMs with .NET, Python, and Java. Provides plugins, function calling, planning, memory, and enterprise-grade AI for existing codebases.

free_tier.summary: Open source under MIT license. Fully free self-hosted with any LLM or Azure AI.

paid_plan.summary: No paid version; framework is free and open source. Azure AI services have separate pricing.

student_benefits.details: Azure AI services have free tier with $200 credits. Framework itself is free.

resources.name: LlamaIndex
resources.description: Data framework for LLM applications with powerful agent and RAG capabilities. Connects LLMs to 160+ data sources with ingestion, indexing, retrieval, and agentic workflows.

free_tier.summary: Open source under MIT license. Self-hosted fully free. LlamaCloud free tier for managed parsing and retrieval.

paid_plan.summary: LlamaCloud: managed parsing and retrieval, custom pricing

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; framework is free and open source

resources.name: Dify

paid_plan.summary: Dify Cloud Pro: paid hosting with higher limits. Self-hosted is free.

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; self-hosted version is free

resources.name: Flowise
resources.description: Low-code, drag-and-drop LLM application builder for creating AI agents, chatbots, and RAG pipelines visually. No coding required to build complex AI workflows with a free tier.

paid_plan.summary: Pay-as-you-go starting at $0.00025/1K input characters (Gemini 1.5 Pro)

paid_plan.summary: Pay-as-you-go starting at €0.004/1K tokens (Mistral Large)

paid_plan.summary: Pay-as-you-go at $0.14/1M tokens (DeepSeek-V2), $0.28/1M tokens (DeepSeek-Coder)
